g.text: TJ Murphy tag gallery: plan (prototype, issue #251)
Tags are a proposal, not yet approved by TJ.
234 paintings · 12 rooms + entrance hall · 17 doorways · every room has 2+ exits, no dead ends

Red brackets: tight sets (triptychs one row in order; Burning Man Temple 2022 four as a 2x2 grid). Wall markers: coloured bar = painting frame at true width; grey bar = plaque. ~ = estimated size.
